ui.name: New Hampshire Employment Security (NHES), Web Tax & New Hire Reporting System

returns.name: Employer Quarterly Tax and Wage Report (WebTax)
contents: Every employer files a tax and wage report for every calendar quarter while providing employment, and pays the unemployment compensation tax when filing.

Due April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31; the summaries say a report filed no later than midnight (Eastern) within 2 business days after the due date is treated as timely (a grace period, not an extension); later reports may incur late fees and interest.
WebTax may only be used by employers with no more than 1,000 employees; larger employers file differently.
(Dates come from a single secondary summary; see the profile's first source.)
